title: LOW-COST COMMUNITY COUNSELLING OPTIONS
introduction: This list has been compiled to assist patients and families in need of low-cost community counselling options. It is comprised of various resources within the Fraser Health and Vancouver Coastal Health catchment areas, most offering supports to all communities regardless of which city you reside (Please note, there are several exceptions included in this list which only serve their surrounding community, for example those clearly indicating “Vancouver residents only” etc.) Please contact the resource which may benefit you to ensure they are still accepting clients and that you are suitable for their services.

items.name: Psychological Services and Counselling Training Centre
items.description: UBC. As part of the Counselling Psychology program, the PSCTC offers counselling sessions to adults and students over the age of 19 from September to April every academic year. The counsellors are UBC Counselling Psychology Master’s and Doctoral students, with an instructor who is onsite supervising the counsellors. Sessions offer support with stress-management (work, home, school stress), anxiety, depression, school, or relationship issues. Counselling sessions are currently offered primarily in-person but with some opportunities for online counselling using Zoom/OWL Practice.
items.raw_source_text:
Psychological Services and Counselling Training Centre – UBC. Sessions offer support with stress-management (work, home, school stress), anxiety, depression, school, or relationship issues. Counselling sessions are currently offered primarily in-person but with some opportunities for online counselling using Zoom/OWL Practice.
Contact: For further information, or to be included on the wait list, please contact the PSCTC by phone 604-822-1364.
